cohort: The study included fetuses with congenital heart defect (n = 86), fetuses with arrhythmia (n = 31), and control fetuses (n = 127) from whom maternal vein, umbilical artery, and umbilical vein samples were collected.
finding: The mother and fetus independently secrete and metabolize both ANP and BNP, with fetal plasma ANP consisting exclusively of the mature form and BNP predominantly of precursor forms, suggesting distinct metabolic pathways in the fetoplacental circulation.
cross-section timing: Samples were taken from maternal vein, umbilical artery, and umbilical vein, implying collection at the time of birth or immediately postpartum.
